insurer_name: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Combined PA + Cancer Secure plan. Cancer cover: 25% SI Minor Stage, 100% SI Major Stage.

permanent_exclusions: Accidents due to suicide / self-inflicted injury
Substance abuse, drug use, alcohol intoxication at time of accident
Aerial activities except as fare-paying passenger
Bacterial infections (except pyogenic infection through accidental wound)
Cancer in situ / non-invasive / low-grade (TNM T1N0M0)
notable_exclusions_summary: Combined Personal Accident + Cancer fixed-benefit plan. PA benefits include: Accidental Death (100% SI), Permanent Total Disability (100% SI), Permanent Partial Disability (per schedule of percentages), Temporary Total Disability (weekly benefit). Cancer cover on diagnosis as fixed payout.
claim_process_summary: PA claims: submit FIR, post-mortem (death), disability certificate from civil surgeon, X-rays/MRI. Cancer claims: diagnosis report, histopathology. Lump-sum payment within 30 days of complete documentation.
